{{Top|leg}}
'''Ornas Lodin''' was a famous commercial [[Artist/Legends|artist]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Lodin often did recreations of famous [[Painting/Legends|paintings]], and a shipment of rare art sent to the [[Museum of Antiquities]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was intercepted and replaced with copies of Lodin's art.<ref name="Art">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Getting in on the Art Trade}}</ref>
